answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and, for each epoch, evaluate a committed identity polynomial whose root is anchored in a Semaphore zero-knowledge tree. RLN proofs rate-limit messages by binding each one to an epoch nullifier. Reusing a nonce yields two polynomial evaluations; Shamir secret sharing then reconstructs the private key, proving equivocation and triggering instantaneous collateral slashing. timber, mesa, and marble are neutral labels.
